repositoryStructure.overview: A standard-go project of 176 files organized into 6 top-level directories (.githooks, .github, cmd, docs, infra, internal), separating entry points, business logic, infrastructure, and documentation.

architecture.overview: An event-driven, AWS-native system built from 4 major components on AWS IAM, AWS Lambda, Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon EC2, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon EventBridge Scheduler. A standard-go project of 176 files organized into 6 top-level directories (.githooks, .github, cmd, docs, infra, internal), separating entry points, business logic, infrastructure, and documentation.

components.name: Domain packages
components.responsibility: Business logic behind small, testable ports

architecture.deploymentTopology: A modular, multi-stack CloudFormation deployment: 13 serverless, 2 compute, 2 storage, and 8 networking resources, with least-privilege IAM (7 roles/policies).
architecture.scalability: Stateless Lambda entry points scale horizontally with request volume.
architecture.reliability: Reliability comes from managed, self-healing Lambda execution.
architecture.security: Security is enforced through least-privilege IAM roles, HMAC-verified webhooks.
insights: The pipeline is fully event-driven: EventBridge Scheduler → Lambda → EC2 start/stop.
It blends serverless ingestion with an on-demand compute host, bounding cost while keeping the front door always available.
81 architecture diagram(s) document the system, aiding onboarding and technical writing.
